selection_method.procedure: Four independently authored, ordered eight-item option lists were prepared from general knowledge only; one randrange(8) draw selected setting, then event, then lighting, then camera/composition.

setting: restored hanok music room opening onto a rain-darkened courtyard at blue hour
quiet contemporary museum conservation studio after closing
empty black-box theater during a technical rehearsal
riverside pavilion wrapped in pale winter dawn fog
circular stone observatory chamber during a distant summer storm
book-lined sound archive room during an after-hours recording session
old railway warehouse converted into an acoustic rehearsal hall
coastal lighthouse keeper room during dense sea fog
event: an opening accented phrase as a breeze lifts one corner of handwritten notation
a measured rehearsal passage just as a reel-to-reel recorder begins turning
a resonant downbeat while rain droplets continue falling from the eaves
a precise accented stroke as a nearby oil lamp flame bends in a draft
a sustained rhythmic phrase while the first thunder flash arrives outside
a concentrated take at the instant a paper timing strip drops from a shelf
a low-register passage as dust shakes loose from a roof beam
a deliberate opening cadence as the lighthouse beam sweeps through the room
lighting: cool blue ambient light with a narrow warm tungsten edge from floor lamps
diffuse skylight mixed with a single amber inspection lamp
deep theatrical indigo wash crossed by one hard white follow-spot
soft fog-filtered dawn with silver rim light and warm reflected floor fill
cold storm daylight punctuated by a brief white lightning edge
warm shaded reading lamps with a cool stripe from a high clerestory window
late-afternoon raking sun through dusty windows with soft bounce fill
rotating cool beam through fog balanced by a steady amber practical lamp
camera_composition: 35 mm documentary frame from a slightly raised three-quarter angle, full instrument spanning the lower half, face and both hands readable
50 mm environmental portrait at seated eye level, diagonal instrument body leading from foreground to performer, both endpoints visible
40 mm wide three-quarter frame from stage-left, performer centered above the full horizontal instrument, hands separated clearly
55 mm low seated viewpoint, full zither in a strong horizontal band, face framed in the upper third and both hand contacts unobstructed
45 mm symmetrical medium-wide frame, circular architecture enclosing a complete view of performer and instrument
50 mm intimate documentary medium-wide, recorder shelves forming depth lines while the complete instrument and hand mechanics remain visible
35 mm oblique medium-wide with converging warehouse beams, entire instrument kept within frame and hands crisply separated
40 mm window-side environmental portrait, full instrument silhouetted low in frame with face and contact points exposed

frozen_concept.setting: A coastal lighthouse keeper room during dense sea fog, adapted for a solitary night performance.
frozen_concept.event: A precise accented geomungo stroke at the instant a draft bends an oil-lamp flame and the lighthouse optic sweeps through the room.
frozen_concept.lighting: Deep theatrical indigo room light crossed by one hard moving white beam, with the oil lamp as a warm practical.
frozen_concept.camera_composition: A low seated 55 mm environmental portrait; the full zither forms a strong horizontal band, the face sits in the upper third, and both hand-to-instrument contacts remain unobstructed.

allowed: visible makeup placement and skin-surface finish
boundaries: no ethnicity, nationality, health, attractiveness, personality, or protected-trait inference
